ayahs.en: When the sky has split [open]
ayahs.e2: When the sky bursts open

ayahs.en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.e2: obeying its Lord as it must
ayahs.tr: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

ayahs.en: And when the earth has been extended
ayahs.e2: and when the earth is flattened out

ayahs.en: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
ayahs.e2: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty
ayahs.tr: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat

ayahs.en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.e2: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺
ayahs.tr: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰ ا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
ayahs.e2: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences
ayahs.tr: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh

ayahs.en: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
ayahs.e2: As for those who are given their record in their right hand
ayahs.tr: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih

ayahs.ar: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابࣰ ا يَسِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: He will be judged with an easy account
ayahs.e2: they will have an easy reckoning

ayahs.en: And return to his people in happiness
ayahs.e2: and will return to their people joyfully

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
ayahs.en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
ayahs.e2: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs
ayahs.tr: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih

ayahs.en: He will cry out for destruction
ayahs.e2: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction

ayahs.en: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
ayahs.e2: and will burn in the blazing Fire

ayahs.en: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
ayahs.e2: For they used to be prideful among their people

ayahs.en: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
ayahs.e2: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them
ayahs.tr: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa

ayahs.en: So I swear by the twilight glow
ayahs.e2: So, I do swear by the twilight

ayahs.en: And [by] the night and what it envelops
ayahs.e2: And by the night and whatever it envelops

ayahs.en: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
ayahs.e2: And by the moon when it waxes full

ayahs.en: [That] you will surely experience state after state
ayahs.e2: You will certainly pass from one state to another

ayahs.en: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe
ayahs.e2: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
ayahs.en: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon

ayahs.en: But those who have disbelieved deny
ayahs.e2: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial

ayahs.en: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
ayahs.e2: But Allah knows best whatever they hide

ayahs.en: So give them tidings of a painful punishment
ayahs.e2: So give them good news of a painful punishment

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
ayahs.e2: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward
ayahs.tr: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
